HTTP Response Code

400

Response Body

FHIR OperationOutcome Resource.

See here

httpResponses.situation: FHIR MedicationRequest / MedicationDispense bundle successfully processed

source.quote:
When a FHIR MedicationRequest or FHIR MedicationDispense bundle is successfully processed the response will contain the following:

HTTP Response Code

201

When an invalid FHIR MedicationRequest or FHIR MedicationDispense is sent to the FHIR Medication interfaces, the response will contain the following:

HTTP Response Code

400

Response Body

FHIR OperationOutcome Resource. See here.

When a FHIR MedicationRequest or FHIR MedicationDispense bundle is successfully processed the response will contain the following:

HTTP Response Code

201

Response Body

FHIR OperationOutcome Resource. See here.

Further explanation:

In case the prescription falls under the Raqeeb scope, it will get assigned a new groupIdentifier value by the central system. This new value will be within the Raqeeb-OID identification range.

Thus, either the newly assigned or the original groupIdentifier will always be shown in the FHIR OperationOutcome Resource in the response of prescription submissions.

After this first submission it remains constant and the groupIdentifier will be not changed at subsequential updates.

Note: Client systems need to make sure, that the prescription in the local system is updated with this new identifier after successful (first) submission, so that subsequent updates are sent with the correct groupIdentifier.

xdsSuccess.description:
In case of success, the response contains the document retrieved.

Depending on document-type, the document will correspond to the specifications in Publish Interfaces (sub-sections for the different document-types) or “iEHR Summary” or “Immunization Card”.
